description.value: AHA Indian Food Paradise is an Indian restaurant in Aldergrove that claims to be the first in the Lower Mainland to serve traditional Hyderabadi Dum Biryani, dosas, all-day breakfast, tandooris, and chaat under one roof. The restaurant offers both dine-in and takeout, and also runs a catering operation. A second location operates in Surrey.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms two locations; OSM coordinates (49.0586°N, 122.4725°W) align with the Aldergrove location at 3087 271St, Aldergrove BC V4W 3H7. Takeout is explicitly confirmed via 'Dine in or Take out' and 'excellent takeaway service' on the homepage. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record contains no address or phone; both sourced from website and assigned to the Aldergrove location based on coordinate match.
This is a two-location business (Aldergrove and Surrey); the OSM node appears to represent only the Aldergrove location — a separate OSM record may exist or be needed for the Surrey location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Indian restaurant with dine-in and takeout; website is live and confirms the Aldergrove location details. Useful stop for touring cyclists in the Fraser Valley.

wow_evidence: first in the Lower Mainland to serve traditional Hyderabadi Dum Biryani
